<function name="SetForceShowExpander" parent="DTree_Node" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Sets whether or not the expand/collapse button (+/- button) should be shown on this node regardless of whether it has sub-elements or not.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="forceShow" type="boolean"></arg>
	</args>
</function>
